This site hosts the practical material for the VISTA workshop.

## Workshop Material

- [VISTA practical workshop](vista_practical_workshop.html)

## Local Rendering

To rebuild the website locally:

```bash
quarto render
```

The rendered website is written to the `docs/` folder. GitHub Pages can serve that folder directly.
